content_length.description: Maximum number of characters of the file content to return, starting at content_offset. Defaults to 8000 so a large file arrives in pages that fit the response, each with a valid content_next_offset to continue from.

content_offset.description: Zero-based character offset to start the returned content from. Use with content_length to page through a large file that a client would otherwise truncate. Compare the returned content length against content_total_length to detect truncation, then re-fetch from content_next_offset. Defaults to 0 (start of file).

file_path.description: The file's path, copied from the `path` field of a skill-get manifest entry (e.g. `references/limits.md`). Sending it as `path` also works.

version.description: Specific skill version to fetch. If omitted, the latest version is returned.
